en: The postcard features a sepia-tone photograph of an impressive neoclassical building with ornate windows and a dome, surrounded by neatly planted trees and bordered by a fence. On the top, printed text reads 'Sundsvall Allm. Läroverket.' The reverse includes handwritten Swedish text, a 1908 postmark from HJÄRDEN, Sweden, and a green Swedish postage stamp. The format is typical of early 20th-century European postcards.
